releases.title: Complete Media Platform, Central Server & Multi-Device Experience
releases.summary: Kinora 0.6.0 expands the standalone desktop app into a complete multi-device media platform with an optional headless Kinora Server, a touch-optimised mobile web remote, a virtualised Live TV guide, a CSP-safe EPUB/PDF canvas reader, guarded Jellyfin/Emby/Plex transport, full native transactional encrypted backups, opt-in prerelease update discovery, and a structured in-app release history.

entries.title: Cinematic Home Stage & Full-Width Layouts
entries.description: Redesigned Home with a widescreen featured spotlight, Quick Jump navigation ribbon, curated rails, and a collapsible companion hub, while expanding Live TV, Movies, Search, and Settings to use the full viewport width.
entries.details: Eliminated permanent side-column squeezing across Live TV, Movies, and Settings; programme details and Quick Look panels open cleanly as contextual slide-out drawers.

entries.title: 10-Foot Television Mode, Gamepad & Remote Navigation
entries.description: Switch cleanly between Desktop and 10-foot TV layouts with D-pad spatial focus navigation, gamepad support, clear focus indicators, and 4K television scaling.
entries.details: Press Ctrl+Shift+T (or Cmd+Shift+T) or change View Mode in Settings to toggle between Desktop and TV interfaces without losing your place.

entries.title: Persistent Universal Player Dock & Sleep Timer HUD
entries.description: Keep live channels and videos playing in a compact dock while browsing other screens, with one-click expand to full screen, audio/subtitle controls, DASH format detection, and an on-screen sleep timer countdown.
entries.details: Includes extended sleep timer presets (up to 120 minutes), automatic stream failure tracking with one-click retry, and honest codec diagnostics.

entries.title: High-Scale Virtualised Live TV Guide & Multi-Tier Matching
entries.description: Browse 10,000+ channels smoothly with 2D virtualised rows and time-windowing, improved multi-tier XMLTV channel matching, custom bouquets, catch-up playback, and DVR series recording rules.
entries.details: Combines exact ID matching, feed-stripped keys, loose regional matching, and unambiguous display-name matching while refusing ambiguous duplicates.

entries.title: Unified Movies, Series & Real-Time Local Media Libraries
entries.description: Browse movies and series across Xtream Codes providers, Jellyfin/Emby/Plex media servers, and local video folders with automatic folder change detection, smart collections, and cross-source deduplication.
entries.details: Preserves distinct cuts and remasters while merging duplicate entries across rails and tracking per-profile watch progress.

entries.title: Guarded Podcast RSS Subscriptions & Episode Progress
entries.description: Subscribe directly to RSS and Atom podcast feeds through Kinora's guarded native fetcher, resume in-progress episodes, mark episodes played, and queue audio in the persistent audio bar.
entries.details: Honest network error reporting replaces silent placeholder feeds when a remote RSS server is unreachable.

entries.title: Real EPUB, CSP-Safe PDF Canvas Reader & OPDS Browser
entries.description: Open local EPUB, PDF, Markdown, HTML, and plain text books directly inside Kinora with a PDF.js canvas viewer (page controls, zoom, and saved page progress), a table of contents, multiple bookmarks, customisable reading themes, and an OPDS catalogue browser.
entries.details: Renders PDFs natively to canvas without weakening Kinora's strict Content Security Policy and validates %PDF- headers before rendering.

entries.title: Dedicated Genre Artwork Collection & 5-Stage Artwork Pipeline
entries.description: Replaced generic geometric genre placeholders with dedicated cinematic genre artwork across parent genres and subgenres, backed by a 5-stage artwork resolver and custom artwork library.
entries.details: Enforces aspect-ratio integrity for posters (2:3), backdrops (16:9), episodes (16:9), and channel logos with per-item custom artwork overrides.

entries.title: Standalone, Central Server & Client Operating Modes
entries.description: Run Kinora independently on one device, host an always-on headless Kinora Server (desktop, Linux systemd service, or Docker), or connect household clients with automatic LAN discovery and guarded stream proxying.
entries.details: Headless server binary compiles with zero GUI dependencies, serves local media with bounded HTTP Range streaming, and reports server/client version compatibility.

entries.title: Touch Mobile Web Remote with QR Pairing, EPG & Media Control
entries.description: Control Kinora from any phone or tablet on your local network using a 6-digit PIN or QR code, featuring a D-pad, interactive seek bar, mobile keyboard, live TV Guide browser, and one-tap media playback.
entries.details: Includes inline device renaming, instant device revocation, PIN rotation, and a per-device security audit log.

entries.title: Conflict-Safe Cross-Device Watch Progress & Library Sync
entries.description: Synchronise favourites, watchlists, and Continue Watching progress across connected Kinora clients in real time over Server-Sent Events without letting stale offline devices overwrite newer progress.
entries.details: Uses timestamp-checked merges on both server and clients alongside CSP-safe native SSE bridging on desktop.

entries.title: Unified Capability Layer, AI Controls & Opt-In Push-to-Talk Voice
entries.description: Operate playback, channel tuning, EPG queries, search, and device checks through one capability-gated service shared by the UI, remote, authorised AI agents, and strictly opt-in push-to-talk voice input.
entries.details: Microphone hardware stays off by default with zero always-on listening, optional spoken replies, and configurable local or external AI provider endpoints.

entries.title: Full Encrypted Backup, Migration Wizard & Native Transactional Rollback
entries.description: Back up preferences, sources, guides, bouquets, DVR rules, podcasts, reading progress, and non-secret platform settings into an AES-256-GCM encrypted archive with SHA-256 verification and full rollback across frontend and native Rust stores if restoration fails.
entries.details: Never exports plaintext provider passwords or pairing tokens; rejects incompatible future backup schemas and flags missing local paths before restore.

entries.title: Automatic Update Notifications, Signed Updater & Offline What's New
entries.description: Receive non-intrusive update notifications when a signed GitHub release is available, toggle background checks, switch between Stable and opt-in Pre-release channels, review release notes, verify Minisign signatures before installing, restart cleanly to apply, and browse full version history offline.
entries.details: Uses ETag-cached GitHub Releases discovery with rate-limit handling, blocks unsigned packages, keeps the installed version intact on failure, and generates What's New, CHANGELOG.md, and release notes from one version-controlled database.

entries.title: API Rate Limiting, Guarded Media Server & Feed Fetching, and Profile Isolation
entries.description: Added sliding-window API rate limiting on Kinora Server, routed Jellyfin/Emby/Plex and podcast/OPDS network requests through Rust's guarded no-redirect anti-SSRF fetcher, updated vulnerable Rust crates (cookie, url), isolated profile libraries, and hardened parental PIN hashing.
entries.details: Maintains strict Content Security Policy, direct no-proxy fetching, memory-only stream handles, and full token redaction in errors.

entries.title: Cache Clearing, QR Encoding, Sidebar Contrast & Routing Fixes
entries.description: Fixed artwork cache clearing in Settings to invoke native storage cleanup, corrected QR code Reed-Solomon format bits for reliable phone scanning, elevated sidebar contrast, and unified BrowserRouter navigation across voice and remote commands.

entries.title: Bottom Navigation Hint Bar Containment & Sidebar Clearance
entries.description: Anchored the TV mode bottom navigation hint bar strictly to the bottom-right of the main content viewport using the dynamic shell inset so it never overlaps the expanded, collapsed, or drawer sidebar, clears the persistent audio bar, and hides automatically when overlays or playback views are open.
entries.details: Mounted RemoteHintBar inside the main content region with z-index below navigation drawers and dialogs, while keeping desktop mode free of unnecessary remote hint clutter.

entries.title: TV Series Poster Framing, Image Loading & Genre Artwork Consistency
entries.description: Fixed poster image loading stalls, moved TV show poster captions cleanly below 2:3 artwork, enforced top-weighted poster framing and aspect-aware fitting across series and detail screens, fixed Home Explore Genres card sizing, unified genre tabs across Movies and TV Shows, and added automatic legacy genre cache migration.

entries.title: Atomic Release Publishing, Build-Revision Detection & Automated Promotion
entries.description: Added atomic two-stage GitHub Release publishing (verifying HTTP 200 reachability of all platform assets before publishing latest.json), build-commit and timestamp revision metadata for safe maintenance refresh detection, gated branch-to-main promotion, container health verification before GHCR publish, full release verification (latest.json, Minisign, SHA256SUMS, CycloneDX SBOM with commit provenance), and a zero-GUI headless server Docker image.

releases.title: Public Desktop Release Candidate
releases.summary: Established Kinora's public desktop release pipeline, signed Tauri 2 updater verification, multi-platform packaging matrices, and authentic cinematic card artwork.

entries.title: Kinora Proprietary Source-Available Licence & Attribution
entries.description: Published Kinora under an explicit All Rights Reserved source-available licence with creator attribution to millsydotdev in Settings > About and project documentation.

entries.title: Signed Multi-Platform Updater & Release Automation
entries.description: Introduced Tauri 2 updater checks against signed GitHub release manifests across Linux (DEB, RPM, AppImage), Windows (NSIS, MSI), and macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel DMG).

entries.title: Home Recommendation Card Visual Parity
entries.description: Restored authentic reference artwork across the Recommended for You rail with consistent 220x185 tile framing.

entries.title: Guarded Update Manifests & Secret Hygiene
entries.description: Enforced HTTPS-only update manifest fetching with anti-SSRF destination checks and completed full working-tree secret verification.

releases.title: Release Candidate Preparation
releases.summary: Delivered multi-platform packaging, unified notifications, macOS hardened runtime support, and Windows atomic persistence fixes.

entries.title: Cross-Platform Installers & SHA-256 Checksum Pipeline
entries.description: Configured Linux, Windows, and macOS bundle targets with automated GitHub Actions release workflows and SHA-256 verification.

entries.title: Unified Notification Drawer & Toast Routing
entries.description: Connected ephemeral toast alerts with a persistent notification history drawer and unread badge counter.

entries.title: Cross-Platform Atomic Storage & CSS Build Stability
entries.description: Fixed Windows directory sync handling during atomic saves and resolved CSS minification syntax issues in production builds.

entries.title: Salted Parental PIN & Memory-Only Stream Handles
entries.description: Protected parental controls with salted hashing and automatic lockout while keeping upstream stream credentials behind opaque local handles.

releases.title: First-Run Onboarding & Honest Sample Mode
releases.summary: Introduced a skippable first-run setup flow with country playlist selection and clear separation between real sources and optional sample data.

entries.title: Guided First-Run Setup & Sample Mode Separation
entries.description: Added step-by-step country playlist onboarding via iptv-org discovery and ensured demo content is opt-in only and clearly labelled.

releases.title: Reliability, Timezone & Test Hardening
releases.summary: Hardened guide schedule handling across daylight saving transitions and expanded automated Vitest and Rust test coverage.

entries.title: Timezone-Safe Guide Scheduling & Expanded Test Suites
entries.description: Added clock-independent schedule calculations for 23-hour and 25-hour daylight saving days and expanded automated test coverage.

releases.title: Public Playlist Discovery Catalogue
releases.summary: Added Discovery browsing of the public iptv-org directory with explicit user confirmation before importing any playlist.

entries.title: iptv-org Public Playlist Discovery
entries.description: Browse curated public country and category playlists and import chosen sources through Kinora's standard guarded M3U pipeline.

releases.title: XMLTV Electronic Programme Guide
releases.summary: Implemented a pure Rust XMLTV parser with entity-attack protection and channel matching for live TV schedules.

entries.title: Guarded XMLTV Parser & Channel Matching
entries.description: Import XMLTV and gzipped XMLTV guides by URL or file with DTD expansion attack refusal and flexible channel matching.

releases.title: Atomic Local Persistence
releases.summary: Added atomic local storage for saved sources with strict POSIX permissions and non-destructive corrupt-file recovery.

entries.title: Atomic Source Persistence & Recovery
entries.description: Saved sources use atomic temp-file renames with restricted permissions (0700/0600) and move damaged files aside without deletion.

releases.title: Guarded Native HLS Playback
releases.summary: Implemented the native kstream protocol and HLS playlist rewriter so upstream stream URLs never leak to the webview.

entries.title: Native Guarded HLS Rewriter & Playback
entries.description: Streams play through opaque local handles with bounded session budgets, cancellation on channel switch, and DRM refusal.

releases.title: Live TV Playlist Integration
releases.summary: Connected imported M3U playlist channels to the Live TV guide, category filters, and channel browsing screens.

entries.title: M3U Channels in Live TV & Categories
entries.description: Imported M3U playlists populate Live TV channels, group chips, and channel search cleanly.

releases.title: Rust M3U Parser & Anti-SSRF HTTP Client
releases.summary: Added native Rust M3U parsing and a guarded HTTP client enforcing direct connections and private network refusal.

entries.title: Guarded Native M3U Ingestion
entries.description: Added bounded M3U parsing in Rust with no-proxy direct fetching, DNS/redirect SSRF checks, and credential-free errors.

releases.title: Initial Desktop UI Baseline
releases.summary: Initial React 19 and TypeScript desktop media interface prototype.

entries.title: Initial Kinora Desktop Interface
entries.description: Established the React 19 and TypeScript interface foundation for Live TV, movies, series, and library views.
